title: Sisters in Fancy Dresses with Stuffed Bunny, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny outdoor portrait featuring an older sister kneeling on a grassy lawn while holding a toddler sister, who cradles a small stuffed toy rabbit. Both girls wear matching or coordinated formal ruffled, puffy party dresses, possibly for Easter or a special family occasion, reflecting post-WWII American suburban domestic life in the early 1950s.
